message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: Defendant broke into a residence (lock picking) to commit theft, but did not obtain any property. So attempted theft (盗窃未遂). In Chinese criminal law, the crime is theft (盗窃罪) attempted (未遂). The label used in examples: For theft attempts, they used "盗窃". Example: In the case of "抢夺" they used "抢夺". For "盗窃;非法狩猎" they used both. For theft attempt, they likely just label "盗窃". In examples, they didn't have a specific "未遂" label; they just gave the base crime. So answer: 盗窃.

Check if any other crimes: maybe "非法侵入住宅" but not in list. The pattern: For break-in without theft, they still charge theft. So answer: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>.
